text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks! Then, could you help me carry the 
pizzas? All 100 of them!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Come on, you know how it is! When you talk 
about a birthday party in our country!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Balloons big enough to lift a house! A 
huge pool! Surprise guests! And!?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—...Pizza. Enough pizza... so our guests 
won't go hungry.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Exactly! For everyone celebrating us, we 
want to hype things up in our own flashy 
style!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...――Understood. However... please 
leave――carrying everything to me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"Life of the party. ...Everyone is waiting 
for the guest of honor."
